sprint_note: Sprint 06: quantity_g column (schema + migration), report alcohol/avg changes in report.py, quantity_g in food.py + entries.py, frontend changes in ReportPage.tsx + EntriesPage.tsx + EntryDetailPage.tsx.

files.role: Adds quantity_g NUMERIC(7,1) NULL column with CHECK constraint to foodtracker.food_logs
Canonical schema snapshot — add quantity_g column and CHECK constraint after alcohol_g
Report aggregation router — extend alcohol_g_total, avg to week/month, alcohol_g_avg

methods.name: _query_logs
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add SUM(alcohol_g) AS alcohol_g_total to SELECT; add alcohol_g_total to returned dict

methods.name: _zero_fill
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Include alcohol_g_total in rows; when include_avgs=True, compute and emit alcohol_g_avg alongside kcal_avg and protein_avg

methods.name: get_report
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Change include_avgs from scope=='year' to scope in ('year','month','week'); extend schema with alcohol_g_total and (when include_avgs) alcohol_g_avg

files.role: Meal intake router — add quantity_g optional scaling

methods.name: _validate_and_normalise
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] After existing validation: read optional top-level quantity_g; validate > 0 if present; scale all nutrition.* by quantity_g/100 when present; cross-field checks on per-100g values; include quantity_g in normalised dict

methods.name: commit_meal
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add quantity_g to INSERT column list and VALUES tuple

files.role: Entry CRUD router — add quantity_g to serialisation, validation, update, and copy

methods.name: _serialise_entry_detail
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add quantity_g: float(row['quantity_g']) if row['quantity_g'] is not None else None

methods.name: _validate_entry_edit_request
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Accept optional quantity_g: number > 0 if present; store float | None in validated dict

methods.name: update_entry
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add quantity_g = %s to UPDATE SET clause; pass validated['quantity_g'] as parameter

methods.name: copy_entry
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add quantity_g to INSERT column list and VALUES; use source['quantity_g'] (may be None)

files.role: Report view — extend NutMetric with alcohol; extend avg line to week/month; add alcohol chart/table view

methods.name: YearComboPanel
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Handle metric==='alcohol': use ALCOHOL_BARS and avgKey='alcohol_g_avg'

methods.name: DataTable
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add alcohol branch: columns bucket_label, alcohol_g_total, alcohol_g_avg (conditional)

methods.name: ReportPage
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add 'Alcohol (g)' View selector option; change isYearScope to showAvgLine = scope !== 'all_time'

methods.name: EntriesPage
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add searchQuery state; add text input above entries list; filter entries by dish_name substring before passing to GroupedEntries

files.role: Entry detail/edit — add quantity_g display and proportional rescale UX

methods.name: EntryDetailPage
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Extend EntryDetail + EntryFormState with quantity_g; show Quantity (g) input when non-null; rescale macros proportionally on quantity_g change; include quantity_g in PUT body
